verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document can be downloaded keylessly from https://supabase.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). That covers both parts of the story: a downloadable file and a machine-readable spec. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec and which API it covers, any statement on how complete or versioned it is, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is usable for client or agent generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
